prompt: A slow cinematic tracking shot down a rain-soaked Tokyo alleyway at night. Neon signs in Japanese reflect off wet cobblestones in streaks of pink, blue, and amber. A single person walks away from camera under a transparent umbrella. Raindrops are individually visible as they splash on puddles, creating concentric ripples. Steam rises from a street vent. Shot on anamorphic lens with shallow depth of field, 24fps, photorealistic.

Extreme macro close-up of golden honey being slowly poured from a wooden dipper onto a stack of warm buttermilk pancakes. The honey stretches and folds in thick, viscous ribbons, catching warm morning sunlight streaming through a kitchen window. Steam rises gently from the pancakes. A single droplet detaches and lands, creating a tiny splash. Shot at 120fps slow motion, shallow depth of field, photorealistic food photography style.

A photorealistic close-up of a snow leopard's face as it turns slowly toward the camera on a windy Himalayan ridge at golden hour. Individual fur strands shift in the cold wind. Its pale green eyes catch the low sunlight with a natural catchlight reflection. Snowflakes drift across the frame. The background shows a soft bokeh of snow-capped peaks. Shallow depth of field, handheld documentary camera style with subtle natural shake, 4K, photorealistic.

A sweeping aerial drone shot following a dark metallic green 1967 Ford Mustang Fastback driving along a cliffside coastal highway in Big Sur, California during late afternoon. The car's chrome trim and curved body panels reflect the ocean and sky. Waves crash against rocks far below, sending white spray into the air. The car's shadow stretches long across the sunlit asphalt. Subtle heat haze rises from the road. Cinematic color grading, photorealistic, 24fps.

A medium close-up of an elderly Japanese man sitting in a sunlit woodworking workshop, speaking directly to camera as if in a documentary interview. His weathered hands rest on a half-finished wooden bowl. Natural micro-expressions play across his face. Sawdust particles float in the golden backlight streaming through a window. His silver hair moves slightly. Shot on a 85mm prime lens, shallow depth of field, natural sound-stage lighting, photorealistic.
